name: GenFirst (EiT end-to-end VAEs and priors)
purpose: Research release for end-to-end training of a latent VAE jointly with a generative prior without latent collapse: phase 1 lets the prior shape the latent geometry, phase 2 lowers prior and entropy weights tenfold so the decoder recovers detail (card).

license.name: CC BY-NC 4.0 (weights); MIT (code)
license.notes: Card states the weights are CC BY-NC 4.0, non-commercial research use only, stricter than the MIT code; the repository LICENSE file read is the MIT text (Copyright 2025 ByteDance and Leng/Singh). The weights are derivative of upstream models (SD VAE, VA-VAE, FLUX.1 VAE, CLIP) whose terms continue to apply. The CC BY-NC 4.0 text was not read separately. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: latent diffusion (flow matching) with a jointly trained VAE; SiT-XL (class-conditional) and MMDiT-XL (text-to-image) priors, 28 blocks, width 1152, about 675M parameters; frozen CLIP-L text encoder
architecture.why_this_design: Card: a latent space that a diffusion prior fits well while remaining a good autoencoder.

variants.notes: whole repo: class-conditional 65.6 GB, text-to-image 42.7, shared latents 42.7, unified text-image 47.4, VAEs 9.5; a single text-to-image prior plus VAE is a small fraction of that (file-level sizes not read)

pc-12gb.notes: 675M-parameter prior at 512x512; per-checkpoint size not read

other: reference code ByteDance-Seed/GenFirst (PyTorch, raw .pt, not diffusers)

benchmarks.name: GenEval overall
benchmarks.variant: EiT T2I variant A, 512x512, no prompt rewriting

weaknesses: Research artifact: 512x512 text-to-image with CLIP-L, no product-grade model
Non-commercial weights; checkpoints are pickles that must be loaded with weights_only=False
The autoregressive EAR instantiation of the paper is not released

tona_fit.reason: A 512x512 research prior with no role for a coding worker; of interest only as a technique (jointly trained VAE and prior) for a future own image path.
